newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Tempo unit, Unilever in distribution deal.
newsitem.headline: Tempo unit, Unilever in distribution deal.

text.p: Indonesia's pharmaceutical firm PT Tempo Scan Pacific said on Tuesday its subsidiary PT Tempo had signed a distribution agreement with consumer goods manufacturer PT Unilever Indonesia.

Under the agreement, the subsidiary will distribute and sell Unilever consumer products including bathsoap Lux, shampoo Sunsilk and other goods, PT Tempo Scan Pacific said in a statement to the Jakarta Stock Exchange authorities.
It said the the subsidiary would distribute the products to drug stores and hospitals throughout Indonesia.
The statement did not give further details.
